title: Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv (EGZ) Theorem (Zero-Sum Subsequence)
title_zh: 埃尔德什-金茨堡-齐夫定理（EGZ 零和子列定理）
category_zh: 加性组合 / 代数数论
summary: Classic zero-sum theorem: among any 2n - 1 integers, some n sum to a multiple of n. Base cases n = 2 and n = 3 are kernel-verified; prime case (Chevalley–Warning / Cauchy–Davenport) and multiplicative reduction are OPEN!
summary_zh: 经典零和定理：任意 2n-1 个整数必含 n 个之和被 n 整除。n=2 与 n=3 已过核验证，素数情形（Chevalley–Warning）与乘法归纳主定理开放悬赏！
